parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity data for human Rho-associated protein kinase 2 (CHEMBL2973). Return compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, relation, value, units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Use the provenance path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure availability. Filter by target CHEMBL2973 and standard_type IC50. Map docs.doi and docs.pubmed_id to pubmed_id_or_doi. Sort by all output columns.
